info.title: Jade GCC API
info.description: App API of the Jade GCC data center monitoring platform. Every request needs an OIDC access token (`Authorization: Bearer …`). Errors are RFC 9457 `application/problem+json`. Lists use cursor pagination (`limit`, `cursor` → `{items, next_cursor}`).

AlertCounts.title: AlertCounts
AlertCounts.description: Unresolved alerts. Severity counts exclude muted alerts (maintenance windows).

target.title: Target
target.description: Comma-separated email addresses, or the Teams incoming-webhook URL. Stored encrypted.

metric.title: Metric
metric.description: Metric code; required except for missing_data.

AlertRuleUpdate.title: AlertRuleUpdate
AlertRuleUpdate.description: Built-in rules keep their type and metric; everything else can be tuned.

component.title: Component
component.description: Firmware key: BIOS, BMC, CPLD, PSU, NIC, RAID or DRIVE:<model>.

cert_fingerprint.title: Cert Fingerprint
cert_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 of the client certificate (mTLS mode).

EffectiveLimit.title: EffectiveLimit
EffectiveLimit.description: The limit that applies to one sensor of a server, and where it comes from (D12 precedence).

Freshness.title: Freshness
Freshness.description: How current the live data is. A server is reporting if its newest reading is under 5 minutes old.

HealthCounts.title: HealthCounts
HealthCounts.description: Servers per worst health. A server with no health data yet counts as Unknown.

ProblemOut.title: ProblemOut
ProblemOut.description: RFC 9457 problem details (media type `application/problem+json`). Extra members may appear.

collector_id.title: Collector Id
collector_id.description: Preferred collector; defaults to the site's least-loaded collector.

ServerCreate.title: ServerCreate
ServerCreate.description: Onboard a server the way an engineer would; vendor, model, serial and parts come from the BMC.

ServerUpdate.title: ServerUpdate
ServerUpdate.description: Only the fields present are changed. `rack_id: null` takes the server out of its rack.

SiteUpdate.title: SiteUpdate
SiteUpdate.description: The code is fixed once created: site groups (`gcc-site-<CODE>`) refer to it.

ThresholdBulkIn.title: ThresholdBulkIn
ThresholdBulkIn.description: Upsert several limits at once, matched by (metric, scope, site, server, vendor, model).

ThresholdIn.title: ThresholdIn
ThresholdIn.description: An override at one scope: model (vendor + model), site, or server. Global rows already exist.

HTTPBearer.description: OIDC access token from the company IdP.
